name: Merari
overview: Merari, identified as one of the sons of Levi alongside Gershon and Kohath, represents a foundational lineage within the Levitical priesthood, as shown in Genesis 46:11 and Numbers 3:17. The descendants of Merari formed distinct families, specifically the Mahlites and Mushites, who were entrusted with particular responsibilities related to the tabernacle (Numbers 3:33-34). Leadership within this group is highlighted through Zuriel, the chief of the Merarite families, who had the specific duty of overseeing their encampment on the north side of the tabernacle (Numbers 3:35). This structure underscores God's orderly design for worship and service through the tribe of Levi.
